The limitation list has no neck option, so I can't map this to one. It's also unclear whether they want to avoid a movement pattern or are describing a symptom, so I'll ask a short question.

Neck isn't something I can build around by name. Is there a movement that bothers you, like overhead pressing, heavy barbell work on your back, or running, that you'd like kept out? Or is the neck itself the problem? If so, that one is for a doctor or physio, and I'll train around whatever they clear.
